kind: Actual local checks; no chain mutations
notes: Initial three tests failed before lifecycle.ts existed.
A focused test rejected role IDs inferred from enum labels; corrected to pinned SDK constants.
KYC transition test rejected equal fields with different JSON order; normalized through evidence whitelist.
SDK first harness build failed due to an unmatched brace. First runtime candidate stopped at issuer role read allowlist; corrected role IDs and SDK getters.
Recovery fixture first failed due to incorrect mock-property setup, then out-of-range ABI args access; fixed fixture. A hung earlier test process was stopped.
Unfiltered synthetic SDK error strings were omitted from the first runtime JSON before publication; failure outcomes and request inventory retained.

The first final-build smoke reached dev but preview 4173 was no longer listening (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED). Restarting the existing preview command resolved it; all four final smoke cases then passed. No application change was needed.
